evidence: Further crystal structure characterizations by transmission electron microscopy and Raman spectroscopy showed that all the films were well crystallized and the main crystal structures of the ALD FeS2, CoS2 and NiS2 were all indeed the pyrite structure, although a minor impurity phase of marcasite was observed for FeS2 (CoS2 and NiS2 were phase-pure pyrites). These ALD films were all found to be of very high purity, as the possible impurity elements such as N, C, and O were all below the detection limit (0.1 at.%) of X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (Figure 3e-h).
